test.name: A craft review reads the prior verdict's craft flag before superseding it
test.description: The second of the two paths issue #848 specified and nobody has observed live. ps_001 already carries one on-demand verdict, and its sidecar body sets "craft": true. Focus and target_id cannot tell a craft read from an evidentiary one — both are focus "on-demand" — so the only way to know whether the prior entry is superseded by this run is to read its body back through sidecar_read and check the flag (agents/gps-mentor.md:308-312). A craft run supersedes only an earlier craft run on the same target.

input.delegation:
The researcher asked how the proof summary for ps_001 reads before they send it to a cousin. Give it a craft review.

focus: on-demand
target_id: ps_001
mode: autonomous
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: This is the direct-agent arm: no routing skill is staged, and the delegation above is relayed verbatim into the agent. Grade the agent's own behaviour — there is no router to catch anything.

The load-bearing call is sidecar_read on the prior entry's file_path, evaluations/on-demand-ps_001-2026-06-02T09-15-00.json. Without reading that body the agent cannot know the prior verdict was a craft read, and so cannot correctly decide supersession. An agent that supersedes (or declines to supersede) without making that call reached the right answer by guessing — that is a fail on Tool work: reading the state the verdict rests on, even if the final verdict is right. Argument quality is the separate base Tool Arguments dimension and is not deducted twice.

The prior body sets "craft": true, so this run's verdict SHOULD supersede ev_001: the new entry is appended and ev_001's superseded_by is updated to the new id, in the same research_append call (agents/gps-mentor.md:299-306).

Craft requests are exempt from the existing-verdict skip — the agent evaluates fresh rather than reporting the prior verdict and stopping (agents/gps-mentor.md:189-193). An agent that returns the prior verdict without producing a new one has skipped work it was told not to skip. The exemption covers the SKIP, not the LOOKUP: the sidecar_read still has to happen.

The new verdict must itself carry "craft": true and must open with the required scope sentence — that it was read for how it reads, not for whether the evidence holds up, naming proof-critique as the review that does (agents/gps-mentor.md:650-655).

Craft findings are advisory. Checks 1-5 never produce a must_address item or an address_first verdict (agents/gps-mentor.md:662) — findings belong in consider_addressing, or non_blocking_notes for nits. An address_first verdict or a non-empty must_address on a craft run is a fail on Correctness.

HARNESS NOTE: research_query, project_context, sidecar_read and research_append are LIVE in this harness — they read and write the staged workspace rather than returning canned responses. The evaluations/ sidecar ships with the scenario and is staged into the workspace, so sidecar_read will resolve it.
The agent must not evaluate whether the evidence holds up. Assessing tier, exhaustiveness or conflict resolution is out of scope for a craft read and is the boundary the scope sentence announces.
